name: model-benchmark
title: Model Benchmark — Engineering Intelligence Evaluation Harness
summary: Evidence-first benchmarking of frontier LLMs on enterprise software-engineering tasks: canonical prompt IR, per-model adapters, machine-enforced fairness contract, deterministic and code-graph grading, blinded judge tribunal, honest cost economics.

runtime.network: outbound HTTPS to configured provider endpoints only

subskills.when: Scoping a study: which models, which lanes, how many trials, expected cost and statistical power.
Adding or revising a model adapter: a new model, a new provider, or a prompt-rendering change.
Writing eval tasks, oracles, seeded vulnerabilities, or mutation-generated ground truth.
Executing a benchmark: compile, validate fairness, invoke, disposition, store.
Turning raw responses into scores: normalize, resolve entities, verify claims, match findings, score, run statistics.
Standing up or operating the blinded judge panel, or calibrating judges against human ground truth.
Producing Pareto frontiers, leaderboards, code-graph uplift analysis, or a model-routing policy.
Versioning a component, migrating a schema, or deciding whether a change requires a backfill.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Environment, registry, pricing staleness and credential-visibility check. Never prints secret values.

commands.name: models
commands.description: Inspect the model registry and per-model capability facts.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Build the canonical IR, render per-adapter prompts, run the fairness validator, emit hashes.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Expand a study into its trial matrix and estimate cost and duration before spending.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute the trial matrix with retry, backoff and disposition handling.

commands.name: grade
commands.description: Normalize, resolve entities, verify claims, match findings against oracles.

commands.name: score
commands.description: Compute quality, calibration, abstention, reliability, economics and statistics.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Render frontiers, iso-budget tables, exclusions and the comparability statement.

commands.name: route
commands.description: Emit a routing policy derived from the measured frontiers.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Replay the bundled cassettes end to end. Run after any scoring change.

invariants: A safety refusal is dispositioned, never scored as a wrong answer.
Vendor effort labels are not a common scale; models are compared at iso-cost / iso-latency budget points.
Cross-provider token counts are never used as a capability metric.
Credentials never enter prompts, manifests, transcripts, cassettes or logs.
The upstream model-prompt-templates library is read-only.
A change to scoring, matching, resolution or the response schema invalidates cross-version comparison until a backfill runs.
